biotools.summary: MeanderViz is a free web application for exploring genomes, assemblies, alignments and microbiome profiles on space-filling Hilbert curves, so that small features remain visible at whole-genome scale. It runs at meanderviz.org and entirely in your browser: files are never uploaded, and there is no login, no cookie and no tracking.
